name: an-intent-before-hello-closes-4003
description: An intent from a client that has not said hello is answered not_authenticated and closed with 4003. A message that fails to parse is answered before the hello too: an unknown intent or type leaves the connection open, and a ping message is answered; such a client is still dropped by the idle deadline.
reason: Nothing is acted on before authentication, and errors never act (HK-224, HK-257).
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.4, v1.7; docs/protocol.md spec v0. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/listener.rs listener_scenarios plays every step through protocol::listener::Listener. Swift: Tests/PowerUpTests/ListenerScenarioTests.swift testEveryListenerScenario plays every step through the bridge (CoreBridge.ListenerPolicy), and ProtocolServerTests drives the same policy over a real loopback socket.
